data.title: 帕瓦 · 街头游戏厅的可乐恶童摆拍
data.description: 涩谷电玩城霓虹闪烁的抓娃娃机前，帕瓦穿着宽大的街头牛仔夹克，内穿贴身红色露脐小背心与牛仔热裤。她一只脚踩在游戏机箱边缘，单手将可乐易拉罐举在头顶，另一手比出狂妄的胜利剪刀手。十字瞳仁闪闪发亮，金红发丝在霓虹变幻中洋溢着无法无天的青春狂气与绝美反差。
data.action: posing energetically on arcade machine step, denim jacket open over red cropped tank top showing midriff, holding soda can overhead, victory sign, sharp toothy grin looking at viewer
data.location: flashy Tokyo arcade interior packed with claw machines and neon game cabinets
data.lighting: vibrant multicolored neon lighting reflecting on denim and blonde locks
data.mood: chaotic high-energy streetwear cool, undeniably vibrant charm
data.promptProse: Posing dynamically inside a neon-lit Tokyo arcade, Power wears an open denim jacket over a red crop top and denim shorts. She hoists a soda can overhead with a sharp-toothed grin and flashing cross-patterned eyes.
data.animaCaption: Power striking a dynamic pose inside a neon arcade with a soda can and denim jacket.
